title: rhamnus × intermedia subsp. istriaca
intro: Rhamnus × intermedia subsp. istriaca, commonly known as the Istriaca buckthorn, is a hybrid plant species within the Rhamnus genus. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Rhamnus × intermedia subsp. istriaca include protecting against oxidative stress, modulating the immune system, and exerting hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, such as vitexin and isovitexin.
